component.name: 2010 Rust Rewrite Mashup
component.summary: MW2, Skate 3 and Minecraft in one Rust game

description.p: 2010 Rust Rewrite Mashup is a from-scratch Rust reimplementation of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2's multiplayer engine that also loads Skate 3 and Minecraft content. It needs the player's own copy of Modern Warfare 2 from Steam to run; a Skate 3 Xbox 360 copy is optional and only unlocks skating. Minecraft's own game files are downloaded from Mojang the first time the Minecraft world is opened.
This is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Activision, Electronic Arts or Mojang.
